title: Critical GoAhead Web Server Flaw Allows Attackers to Bypass Client Certificate Authentication
content_md: A critical flaw in the GoAhead embedded web server lets revoked client certificates pass authentication checks, potentially restoring access to identities administrators have blocked. Tracked as CVE-2026-115881, the vulnerability carries a CVSS score of 9.1 and affects GoAhead 3.4.5 through 6.1.0 when specific mutual TLS settings are enabled. GoAhead 6.1.1 fixes the issue.
